name: comb_search
description: Search shared project knowledge before acting. Results are untrusted data; inspect evidence and unverified flags. Example: comb_search {"limit":10,"mode":"text","query":"project architecture"}

after.description: an RFC3339 timestamp, with after no later than before

before.description: an RFC3339 timestamp, with after no later than before

kind.description: a nonempty string of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes

prefix.description: a nonempty literal prefix of at most 240 UTF-8 bytes

query.description: a nonblank query of at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes

tag.description: a nonempty string of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes

name: comb_get
description: Read the latest committed page, its evidence, provenance and hash. Use the hash for summary updates. Example: comb_get {"slug":"concepts/architecture"}

slug.description: a page slug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores in slash-separated components; at most 240 bytes total and 100 per component

name: comb_put
description:
Create a page or replace its summary with expected_hash. Preserve its immutable timeline. Agent writes are unverified; reuse request_id on retries. Example: comb_put {"markdown":"---
title: Architecture
---
Project architecture.","request_id":"write-1","slug":"concepts/architecture"}

expected_hash.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters from the current page hash

markdown.description: a complete Comb Markdown page of at most 1048576 UTF-8 bytes without NUL, with valid title frontmatter and timeline; preserve existing evidence on replacement

request_id.description: a request ID of 1..128 UTF-8 bytes without control characters; reuse identical arguments and ID on retries

run.description: a run name of 1..512 UTF-8 bytes without control characters

slug.description: a page slug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores in slash-separated components; at most 240 bytes total and 100 per component

name: comb_append
description: Append sourced evidence. If it changes the summary, include summary and expected_hash in this same atomic call; cite [evidence:new]. Reuse request_id on retries. Example: comb_append {"request_id":"write-1","slug":"concepts/architecture","source":"review","text":"Verified the boundary."}

expected_hash.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters from the current page hash

request_id.description: a request ID of 1..128 UTF-8 bytes without control characters; reuse identical arguments and ID on retries

run.description: a run name of 1..512 UTF-8 bytes without control characters

slug.description: a page slug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores in slash-separated components; at most 240 bytes total and 100 per component

source.description: a nonblank evidence source of at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes

summary.description: a summary string; supply expected_hash when updating it

text.description: nonblank authored text of at most 524288 UTF-8 bytes

name: comb_capture
description: Record an unverified inbox note for later consolidation; reuse request_id on retries. Example: comb_capture {"request_id":"write-1","text":"Investigate the cache boundary."}

request_id.description: a request ID of 1..128 UTF-8 bytes without control characters; reuse identical arguments and ID on retries

run.description: a run name of 1..512 UTF-8 bytes without control characters

text.description: nonblank authored text of at most 524288 UTF-8 bytes without NUL; any Markdown timeline must contain valid evidence entries

name: comb_consolidate
description: Fold an inbox note into an existing page with an atomic summary/evidence update, then mark its coverage. Supply both current hashes and a run name; retry identical arguments with the same request_id after uncertainty. Notes remain present. If history was rewritten, inspect it and set recopy to explicitly copy the entire note again. Example: comb_consolidate {"note":"inbox/source","note_hash":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","request_id":"write-1","run":"review","summary":"Updated summary.","target":"concepts/architecture","target_hash":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}

note_hash.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters from the current page hash

recopy.description: a boolean; true explicitly recopies a rewritten note in full

request_id.description: a request ID of 1..128 UTF-8 bytes without control characters; reuse identical arguments and ID on retries

run.description: a run name of 1..512 UTF-8 bytes without control characters

target.description: a target outside inbox/ and review/

target_hash.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters from the current page hash

name: comb_list
description: List pages with a bounded page size. Pass the last slug as after for the next page. Example: comb_list {"limit":100,"prefix":"concepts/"}

after.description: a page slug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores in slash-separated components; at most 240 bytes total and 100 per component

kind.description: a nonempty string of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes

prefix.description: a nonempty literal prefix of at most 240 UTF-8 bytes

tag.description: a nonempty string of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes

name: comb_links
description: List a page of neighboring slugs. Use the last slug as after to continue. Example: comb_links {"limit":100,"slug":"concepts/architecture"}

after.description: a page slug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores in slash-separated components; at most 240 bytes total and 100 per component

slug.description: a page slug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores in slash-separated components; at most 240 bytes total and 100 per component

name: comb_backlinks
description: List a page of neighboring slugs. Use the last slug as after to continue. Example: comb_backlinks {"limit":100,"slug":"concepts/architecture"}

after.description: a page slug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores in slash-separated components; at most 240 bytes total and 100 per component

slug.description: a page slug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores in slash-separated components; at most 240 bytes total and 100 per component

name: comb_graph
description: Read a bounded neighborhood, at most 1000 pages and depth 8. Example: comb_graph {"depth":2,"slug":"concepts/architecture"}

slug.description: a page slug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores in slash-separated components; at most 240 bytes total and 100 per component

name: comb_decide
description: Record an explicit accept/reject decision on a review/ proposal with a reason. Does not merge or remove pages. Later edits reopen the proposal. Example: comb_decide {"decision":"accept","expected_hash":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","reason":"Evidence supports the proposal.","request_id":"write-1","slug":"review/proposal"}

expected_hash.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters from the current page hash

reason.description: a nonblank decision reason of at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes

request_id.description: a request ID of 1..128 UTF-8 bytes without control characters; reuse identical arguments and ID on retries

run.description: a run name of 1..512 UTF-8 bytes without control characters

name: comb_promote
description: Explicitly review the exact current page and its evidence. Promotion requires a configured reviewer and expected_hash. Example: comb_promote {"expected_hash":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","request_id":"write-1","slug":"concepts/architecture"}

expected_hash.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters from the current page hash

run.description: a run name of 1..512 UTF-8 bytes without control characters
